feeds.title: Music & Life Blog » Grime
feeds.description: Read about grime music and how it relates to my mood. I love everything about music and I'm a firm believer in music being the best kind of therapy. My slogan 'Music is Life' is because I truly believe there is a song out there for every feeling. This blog is an outlet for me to express my feelings through words relating to music.

feeds.title: The Art of Grime
feeds.description: The Art of Grime is a blog run by me, Ryan. It's intended as a space for me to push music that I like and hopefully be able to give space to artists through interviews. The Art of Grime isn't intended to be a definitive canon on grime or the final word on the genre, it's words about artists and music that catches my ear.
